testo:
Slayer
World Breaker
■ When you put this creature or it attacks, choose one of your opponent's creatures. That creatures power becomes 0 until the end of the turn.
■ Each turn, when one of your opponent's creatures attacks for the first time, that creature's power becomes 0 until the end of the turn.
■ This creature can't leave while it has 0 power or less.
